metadata.case_name: ALI RAFAQAT v. WISE SECURITY LTD AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.expected_occupation_after: security guard (less demanding building security) / or continued work as salesman

injuries.description: SL carpal ligament injury (tear) of right wrist
source: CT scan of the right wrist was done on 19 May 2006. It showed a widening of the scapho-lunate (“SL”) distance and the diagnosis was SL carpal ligament injury and right thumb metacarpo-phalangeal joint (“MCPJ”) sprain injury.
On 6 December 2006, scarring of the Plaintiff’s right thumb MCPJ with synovitis and tear of the SL ligament were found.

injuries.description: Right thumb metacarpo-phalangeal joint (MCPJ) sprain with scarring and synovitis
source: CT scan of the right wrist was done on 19 May 2006. It showed a widening of the scapho-lunate (“SL”) distance and the diagnosis was SL carpal ligament injury and right thumb metacarpo-phalangeal joint (“MCPJ”) sprain injury.

injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of metacarpophalangeal joint of thumb

manifestations.description: residual tenderness in his right wrist and thumb with some impaired sensation in the ulnar border of the right thumb except the tip
Movements of the right thumb and right wrist were slightly limited
some residual pain and stiffness may remain in the right wrist and right thumb
He cannot pick up heavy objects and has to take 2 tablets of painkiller during cold weather
He cannot play cricket now as his right hand is not strong enough
Work evaluation showed capable of performing reaching, handling and finger dexterity at all levels but with a below standard rate when compared with industrial standard

treatments_received: operation for reconstruction of the SL ligament (20 March 2007)
treatments_future: possible future surgery if condition worsens (may require fusion of the proximal carpal row)

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Cannot play cricket now as his right hand is not strong enough

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Cannot pick up heavy objects; pain when picking up heavy cloth or 3 to 4 suits
Persistent pain, stiffness, residual tenderness and impaired sensation in right wrist and right thumb
